name: Mangatarem Traveller's Inn
description: A cozy inn located in the heart of Mangatarem, perfect for tourists exploring the cultural heritage sites of Pangasinan. Clean rooms, friendly staff, and affordable rates.

rooms.name: Standard Single Room
rooms.description: A comfortable single room with air conditioning and TV.

rooms.name: Deluxe Twin Room
rooms.description: Spacious twin room perfect for friends or couples. Includes private bathroom.

rooms.name: Family Room
rooms.description: Large room that can accommodate up to 4 guests. Great for families visiting Mangatarem.

name: Pangasinan Heritage Lodge
description: Experience Pangasinan hospitality at its finest. Our lodge offers panoramic views and easy access to heritage sites and the local market.

rooms.name: Superior Room
rooms.description: Well-appointed room with garden view and modern furnishings.

rooms.name: Heritage Suite
rooms.description: Premium suite with local Pangasinan décor, king bed, and balcony overlooking the garden.

name: Lola's Bangus Kitchen
description: Serving the freshest bangus (milkfish) dishes in Mangatarem since 1985. A local institution famous for Bangus Sisig, Inihaw na Bangus, and traditional Pangasinan cuisine.

menu_items.name: Bangus Sisig
menu_items.description: Crispy chopped bangus served on a sizzling plate with egg and calamansi

menu_items.name: Inihaw na Bangus
menu_items.description: Whole grilled bangus stuffed with tomatoes and onions

menu_items.name: Pinapaitan
menu_items.description: Traditional Pangasinan bitter soup made with beef innards

menu_items.name: Puto Calasiao
menu_items.description: Soft white rice cakes — a Pangasinan delicacy

name: Kape Mangatarem
description: A modern Filipino café blending Pangasinan coffee traditions with contemporary drinks. Great workspace for digital nomads with fast WiFi.

menu_items.name: Kapeng Barako
menu_items.description: Strong Filipino liberica coffee, locally roasted

menu_items.name: Iced Spanish Latte
menu_items.description: Espresso with sweetened condensed milk over ice

menu_items.name: Bangus Belly Panini
menu_items.description: Toasted panini with crispy bangus belly, pickled onions, and garlic aioli

menu_items.name: Mango Graham Shake
menu_items.description: Creamy mango shake with graham crumble and whipped cream

menu_items.name: Ensaymada
menu_items.description: Soft buttery bread with sugar and cheese topping
